verdict.rationale: MX documents official Web and React Native SDKs, but these only embed the Connect Widget. For the Platform API itself, the evidence shows only an official OpenAPI specification on GitHub that can be imported into Postman, not first-party language client libraries. Missing for 10: official server-side SDKs for the Platform API in mainstream languages, SDK reference docs or install guides, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
